Choice.hint: Debt collection: Attempts to collect a debt: collection calls or letters, debts the customer says are not theirs or already paid, threats or harassment, requests to validate a debt.
Bank accounts: Checking or savings accounts: opening or closing accounts, deposits and withdrawals, overdraft and account fees, frozen accounts, unauthorized transactions on a bank account.
Credit and prepaid cards: Credit cards or prepaid cards: charges on a statement, card fees and interest, purchase disputes and chargebacks, rewards, card applications or closures.

Money transfers and digital payments: Payment apps, wire transfers, digital wallets, virtual currency and money orders: sending or receiving money, missing or fraudulent transfers, access to payment app accounts.
Mortgages: Home loans: applying, servicing and escrow, mortgage payments, loan modification, foreclosure, closing, home equity loans.
Student loans: Federal or private student loans: repayment plans, servicer problems, forgiveness or discharge, payment application, default.
Auto and personal loans: Vehicle loans or leases, payday loans, title loans, personal loans and advance loans: payments, repossession, loan terms, fees and interest.

Credit reports and credit repair: Errors or disputes on credit reports, identity theft appearing on a credit report, improper use of a report, credit monitoring, credit repair or debt settlement services.

Urgent: Active or imminent harm: fraud or identity theft in progress, money being lost or withheld right now, imminent foreclosure, repossession or eviction, legal threats or deadlines within days, harassment.
Standard: A concrete problem that needs action but no imminent harm: wrong fees or charges, account or payment errors, incorrect information, delayed processing, disputes already in progress.
Low: Questions, requests for information or documents, general dissatisfaction, feedback, or issues already resolved.
